chunks: Then they found one of Our votaries, whom We had blessed and given knowledge from Us.
ai.seo_question: Who is the servant of God endowed with special mercy and divine knowledge in Surah Al-Kahf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse identifies Al-Khidr as a servant possessing 'ilm al-ladunni', a unique, divinely bestowed knowledge that complements the prophetic law brought by Musa. This encounter underscores the coexistence of exoteric jurisprudence and esoteric spiritual insight, a duality often reflected in the roles of the Imams who hold both the apparent and hidden truths of revelation.
